name: java-version-incompatibility
description: Handling Java version compatibility issues in Maven projects.
problem: Maven compilation fails with 'invalid flag: --release' or project requires Java 17+ but only Java 8 is available

approach_1_upgrade_java.label: Upgrade Java (Preferred if possible)
steps: Or install Java 21 LTS: `winget install Eclipse.Temurin.21`

approach_2_downgrade_project.label: Downgrade Project Configuration (if Java upgrade not possible)
steps: Edit pom.xml to downgrade Spring Boot version
Change parent version: 3.1.5 → 2.7.14 (Spring Boot 3 requires Java 17+; 2.7 supports Java 8-11)
